rows.stated:
SIDE-archimedean · Reflection.lean
  ==================================

  The Archimedean / √ IDENTIFICATION of σ = 1/2.

  Checkpoint 1.2-A in the alternative-proof-paths census
  (PATHS_TO_THE_CRITICAL_LINE). An IDENTIFICATION kernel — same
  status as Voice1 (Euler balance), Voice6 (spectral), and the
  Frobenius checkpoint: it verifies the Archimedean machinery
  POINTS at σ = 1/2. It does NOT prove RH on its own — that needs
  the exhaustive mechanism catalogue.

  The path: n² → θ(τ) → the √ transformation θ(−1/τ) = √(−iτ)·θ(τ)
  → the functional equation ξ(s) = ξ(1−s) → Focus (ξ real on the
  critical line, codim 2 → 1) at σ = 1/2.

  Source: CRITICAL RESOLVE Path One; A Place to Stand (√ mechanism,
  Focus); SIDE-kernel Voice3 (reflect_fixed_iff).
rows.licensed: The file compiles only rational arithmetic: fe_reflect σ = 1 − σ has fixed point 1/2 (:37), a focus_codim defined as `if σ = 1/2 then 1 else 2` (:46) picks out the same point (:48, :54), and 2·(1/2) = 1 (:30); no theta function, √ transformation, functional equation of ξ or Focus is stated, so "it verifies the Archimedean machinery POINTS at σ = 1/2" claims more than any declaration of the file states (the "does NOT prove RH" disclaimer is correct).
rows.action: RE-CUT: An IDENTIFICATION kernel over ℚ: it proves that the fixed point of the reflection σ ↦ 1 − σ is σ = 1/2 and that a codimension count defined to be 1 exactly at σ = 1/2 picks out the same point; the path n² → θ → √ transformation → ξ(s) = ξ(1−s) → Focus is the reading, not stated in this file, and it does not prove RH.

rows.licensed: Section heading for theta_weight := 1/2 and 2·theta_weight = 1, both compiled; it claims no more.

## T3 — Focus: the codimension collapse

At σ = 1/2, Schwarz reflection + the FE force ξ real (Im ξ = 0): a
zero needs one real equation, not two (codim 2 → 1). Off the line a
zero needs Re ξ = Im ξ = 0.
rows.licensed: The block states as the reading the classical fact that ξ is real on the critical line (Schwarz reflection + FE) and claims no compiled status for it; the declaration below defines focus_codim as 1 at σ = 1/2 and 2 elsewhere and proves the iff.
